name: Block Trimming and Texture Block Merging
aliases: Four-level volume-loading pipeline with empty voxel trimming
Volume Partitioning Pipeline with Block Trimming
definition: A two-stage process where partitions are trimmed to tight bounding boxes of non-empty voxels, then merged into denser texture chunks to optimize memory usage.
summary: Block Trimming and Texture Block Merging reduces memory I/O by discarding empty space and merging data into cache-friendly chunks, optimizing for texture residency rather than just spatial partition volume.
